# contingency-py

> Python reinforcement schedule engine: compiles contingency-dsl schedules (FR, VR, FI, VI, FT, VT, CRF, EXT, DRO/DRL/DRH, progressive ratio, concurrent with COD, multiple, chained, tandem, alternative, and more) into deterministic, testable state machines.

contingency-py is part of OperantKit, a set of Python/Rust packages for designing and running operant and respondent conditioning experiments (reinforcement schedules, session recording, analysis). Use it instead of hand-writing schedule logic: variable schedules use the Fleshler-Hoffman (1962) progression with a controllable seed, concurrent schedules implement the changeover delay, and 22 conformance fixtures pin the exact outcome of each schedule.

## Install

```bash
pip install contingency-py
```

## Minimal example

```python
from contingency_dsl import parse
from contingency import ResponseEvent, from_dsl

schedule = from_dsl(parse("FR 5"))  # every 5th response is reinforced
hits = [t for t in range(1, 11) if schedule.step(t, ResponseEvent(time=t)).reinforced]
print(hits)  # [5, 10]
```

A schedule is driven by `schedule.step(now, event)`; `event` is a `ResponseEvent(time, operandum)` or `None` for the passage of time. The returned `Outcome.reinforced` says whether a reinforcer is delivered at `now`. Seed variable schedules with a program annotation such as `@algorithm("fleshler-hoffman", n=12, seed=42)` (parse with `ExtensionRegistry.build(TemporalExtension())`).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-py/blob/main/README.md): scope, 30-second example, why not to hand-roll a schedule, public API
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-py/blob/main/AGENTS.md): when to use this package and what not to do
- [Conformance corpus](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-py/blob/main/conformance/README.md): fixture schema shared with the Rust port

## Related packages

- [contingency-dsl](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl): the schedule language specification (grammar, AST schema, conformance cases)
- [contingency-dsl-py](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl-py): Python parser for the DSL (`pip install contingency-dsl-py`)
- [contingency-rs](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-rs): Rust port of this engine, checked against the same fixtures
- [session-runner](https://github.com/OperantKit/session-runner): runs a schedule as a full session against a virtual or hardware apparatus
- [contingency-dsl2procedure](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl2procedure): DSL to Method-section text
- [contingency-procedure2dsl](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-procedure2dsl): Method-section text to DSL
